scope: Registry-level defaults and paper-intent gate, now enforced by the live legacy intraday runner for local-paper versus shadow attribution; not yet integrated in every historical book writer.
implemented: Unknown strategy IDs resolve to SHADOW_ONLY and cannot emit paper intents.
Paper intent authorization requires exact registry membership plus a paper-capable registered status.
A caller-created PAPER_ELIGIBLE spec or stale version is rejected when it is not the exact current registered spec.
Shadow signals remain quantity-free observations; human approval is still required for the transition into PAPER_ELIGIBLE.

The legacy intraday paper runner defaults missing registries, unknown strategies, monitoring families, and non-paper-capable statuses to shadow attribution; only an exact currently registered paper-capable spec can enter the local-paper lane.

tests.result: 58 passed (exit code 0) across F02 registry and legacy intraday runner tests; Ruff and mypy passed for changed modules.

limitations: Historical paper-book writers and other legacy strategy runners are not all wired into the registry gate.
Static eligibility inventory is still narrower than all 253 source-linked candidates.
